recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast black and white duo portrait contained within a thick black border, tilted at a dynamic angle against a white field, featuring prominent slab-serif typography aligned to the top edge of the inner frame.
coreVisualRelationships: Tilted inner frame relative to the square outer canvas
High-contrast facial shadows against bright highlights
Typography following the rotation of the inner image border
Tight cropping on two subjects with overlapping shoulders

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two male subjects occupy 80% of the inner frame, positioned side-by-side in a medium close-up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The high-contrast eyes and smiles of the subjects.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye enters at the top-left text, follows the diagonal tilt down through the faces, and exits at the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space outside the tilted frame provides breathing room and emphasizes the rotation.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black shadows and frame lines
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays for skin texture and clothing patterns
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast with no hue; high-key lighting on faces.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and light transitional serif
letterConstructionRules: Display text uses thick, blocky serifs with uniform stroke weight
Subtitle text uses high-contrast strokes with bracketed serifs
All text is rotated to match the image frame angle
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy mechanical slab serif paired with a delicate, high-contrast transitional serif for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif display style
Matches the light, elegant serif subtitle style

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white portrait of two men with 1970s hairstyles and clothing. Place this image inside a thick black rectangular frame. Tilt the entire framed image 15 degrees counter-clockwise against a solid white background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold slab-serif uppercase text in the top left corner, following the 15-degree tilt. Add a secondary line of light serif text slightly to the right, partially overlapping the top black border of the image.

verificationChecks: Is the inner frame tilted relative to the canvas?
Does the text align perfectly with the tilted border?
Is there a clear hierarchy between the heavy and light fonts?

avoid: Horizontal text on a tilted image

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no color bleed is present
Check that the slab serif is sufficiently heavy
Verify the tilt angle is consistent across all elements
Confirm the background is pure white
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a high-contrast B&W portrait, enclose in a thick black stroke, rotate the entire assembly 15 degrees, and place slab-serif type along the top rotated axis.
